mapper.sql: SELECT br.id, br.requester_id, br.approver_id, br.status, br.requested_at, br.approved_at, bri.id AS item_id, bri.book_request_id, bri.title AS item_title, bri.isbn AS item_isbn, bri.author_id AS item_author_id, bri.published_year AS item_published_year, bri.estimated_price AS item_estimated_price FROM book_requests br LEFT JOIN book_request_items bri ON bri.book_request_id = br.id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM book_requests WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY requested_at
mapper.update: UPDATE book_requests SET status = 'REJECTED', approver_id = #{approverId}, approved_at = #{approvedAt} WHERE id = #{bookRequestId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND requester_id != #{approverId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_requests (requester_id, status, requested_at, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{requesterId}, #{status}, #{requestedAt}, #{idempotencyKey})
